operators.name: softplus_forward
semantics: Computes y = softplus(x) = log(1 + exp(x)) elementwise, matching torch.nn.functional.softplus with default beta=1, threshold=20.
For numerical stability, when x > 20, returns x directly; otherwise computes log1p(exp(x)).
Preserves input shape, dtype (float32), device (cuda), and stride/layout in output.
Operates only on CUDA tensor; input must be float32. The CUDA kernel uses grid-stride loop to handle arbitrary numel.
Applies softplus elementwise to the input tensor x.
Output shape equals input shape [4096, 128, 512], float32, cuda:0.
Reference uses PyTorch's fused softplus implementation; for x > 20 returns x to avoid overflow.
No broadcasting, reduction, or weight parameters involved.
